title: Culmina — current application map

nodes.label: Tonight
nodes.note: The tab can display a selected night other than tonight.

nodes.label: What can I image?
nodes.note: Selecting a row changes the working target and returns to the caller; it does not create a scored recommendation.

nodes.label: Capture Plan
nodes.note: SessionPlannerRoute wraps this screen. current opens the working plan; a numeric id can open a stored plan. Save is an action on this screen, not a destination.

nodes.label: Site and night
nodes.note: Apply changes updates the working draft. Close discards unapplied choices.

nodes.label: Choose target
nodes.note: Scoped selection with Apply changes.

nodes.label: Choose rig
nodes.note: ?for=plan preserves the create-and-select rig flow. An empty list can replace this screen with Manage rigs.

nodes.label: Capture block editor
nodes.note: Despite its historical function name, this is a full-page editor. Add/Edit returns a block; the caller applies it with Undo.

nodes.label: Build calibration frames
nodes.note: A full-page preview, despite the historical dialog filename. Explicit application; calibration inside/outside the window and from a library remain distinct.

nodes.label: Plan assumptions
nodes.note: These are per-plan overrides, separate from global planning defaults.

nodes.label: Planning settings over Plan
nodes.note: Global defaults; Back returns to Plan. Different scope from per-plan assumptions.

nodes.label: Unsaved changes
nodes.note: Save / Discard / Cancel. The captured example is a Library editor; Plan wording and callers vary.

nodes.label: Night
nodes.note: Night and Moon share a page controller; /moon opens the Moon page.

nodes.label: Moon
nodes.note: The Moon page of NightMoonScreen, not an independent bottom tab.

nodes.label: Weather
nodes.note: Wrapper opens NightMoonScreen at page 2. Night / Moon / Weather are panes of one conditions browser; switching pane does not require a new router path. Forecast / cache / offline-refresh states remain distinct.

nodes.label: Logbook
nodes.note: The technical route is /sessions; the visible tab is Logbook.

nodes.label: Saved plan / entry
nodes.note: Shows planned and recorded information. Upcoming saved plans can reopen in Plan; other states offer record/edit result or copy.

nodes.label: Record result
nodes.note: Recorded result is distinct from fit and a saved plan. Recording availability depends on the saved night and entry state.

nodes.label: Progress by target
nodes.note: Aggregates recorded results; a planned integration is not a recorded result.

nodes.label: Library
nodes.note: Manages rigs, targets and sites.

nodes.label: Rigs
nodes.note: ListMode.manage; tapping opens a record rather than silently selecting a plan rig.

nodes.label: Rig record
nodes.note: Existing profile with specifications and their evidence; no invented sensor data.

nodes.label: Rig editor
nodes.note: New, edit or metadata-prefilled draft; explicit Save rig.

nodes.label: Manage rigs over chooser
nodes.note: Same management screen in a different navigation context; ?for=plan can select a newly created rig.

nodes.label: Target record
nodes.note: Plan this target starts a new plan after the leaving guard. A candidate-row tap has a different contract.

nodes.label: Target editor
nodes.note: Add/edit targets, including the existing catalogue edit path; untouched catalogue values retain their provenance.

nodes.label: Manage targets over chooser
nodes.note: Library management above the scoped target chooser.

nodes.label: Site record
nodes.note: Stored site and its provenance; not the transient map position.

nodes.label: Choose site
nodes.note: ListMode.choose; Tonight opens this directly. A row selects the site immediately without closing; the Manage site icon opens its record. Different from the unapplied choices in Plan context.

nodes.label: Site editor
nodes.note: Receives typed SiteEditorArgs. Restored lost arguments return to Library sites instead of opening a different form.

nodes.label: Current / transient position
nodes.note: Transient position for map/GPS; not equivalent to a stored selected site. Map tiles/GPS permission are platform boundaries.

nodes.label: Map coordinate picker
nodes.note: pickOnly=true for the site editor; typed LatLng extra. Lost restored arguments return to Library sites.

nodes.label: Add from a photo
nodes.note: Review imported metadata and create a rig draft; native file-picker behavior is not verified by a host render.

nodes.label: Appearance
nodes.note: Named MaterialPageRoute /settings/appearance, not a GoRoute. Theme, units and Android-controlled text size.

nodes.label: Planning defaults
nodes.note: Named MaterialPageRoute /settings/planning; global settings with explicit draft Save.

nodes.label: Privacy
nodes.note: Named MaterialPageRoute /settings/privacy. Optional place-name lookup and its consent.

nodes.label: Backup & data
nodes.note: Named MaterialPageRoute /settings/backup. Backup, preview and restore operations have separate confirmation/platform boundaries.

nodes.label: Open-source licenses
nodes.note: Opened with showLicensePage; not a custom named GoRoute.

nodes.label: Welcome / setup
nodes.note: First-run route is chosen from TonightViewModel state, not always shown on app launch.

limits: Fresh host renders establish captured compositions only. Edges are traced from current production callers, not an exhaustive interaction test. Android, TalkBack, all error states, themes and text scales are not revalidated by this map. System file pickers, permissions and external share/map endpoints are boundaries, not internal routes.

tabNavigation.behavior: Bottom tabs exist only at the four root paths. Each branch keeps its stack. A reselected tab can reset its branch; Back at another root returns to Tonight. Root overlays and detail pages return to their caller.

stateModel.label: Working draft
stateModel.meaning: Edits can be persisted for recovery; this is not explicit Save plan.

stateModel.label: Saved plan
stateModel.meaning: Explicit snapshot. Later changes are Saved · changed until saved again.

stateModel.label: Fit verdict
stateModel.meaning: Independent time-placement analysis: not a persistence or result state.

stateModel.label: Recorded result
stateModel.meaning: Reported imaging outcome; not implied by planned integration or Fits.
